info.title: NPI Launch Risk Digital Twin
info.description: NPI launch risk digital twin: exact CPM, resource-constrained CP-SAT, Monte Carlo simulation, risk attribution, scenario comparison and budget-constrained intervention optimisation with a grounded AI copilot.
